verdict.rationale: The docs confirm you can send a photo into a Grok Bot chat from the iPhone share sheet [grok-bot-docs-21]. A community user also reports a bot generating a pattern from their logo [grok-bot-comm-5], which suggests some image handling. Nothing documents how the assistant interprets screenshots or photos or how accurate that is, and the files page lists only text and data formats [grok-bot-docs-28]. Missing for 10: documented image or screenshot understanding, desktop or Android image upload, any accuracy evidence, and independent hands-on confirmation of correct visual interpretation.
